name: frozen-signal-centering-2026-10-20
hypothesis: Fixed MLPs have positive within-session ranks but negative pooled covariance. A causal ridge level anchor may isolate common-component forecast error without fitting new weights.
weights: Fixed coefficients1/-1/+1; equal-weight26-symbol means; no fitted weight or intercept

availability.panel: Every declared tradable symbol exactly once per session; no subset, carry-forward, missing-symbol substitution or future cohort
availability.decision_cutoff: Maximum feature_available_time of the same-session26-symbol panel
availability.required: Every feature available on its decision session; cutoff strictly before every panel row's next entry-session UTC midnight
availability.labels: Never passed to the transformation; only used afterward for descriptive scoring

diagnostic_gate: Reuse source numeric MSE/IC/year/seed gate without alteration, and report paired change from raw forecasts. Any pass is descriptive only.

constraints.probe: 2018-2020 internal training probe already used in development; not fresh evidence
constraints.trading: Return forecasts only; no orders, simulation-rule changes, PPO allocation or four-action policy substitution
